summary: Ofer Mendelevitch from Vectara presents Enterprise Deep Research as a transformative enterprise AI application that extends web-scale deep research capabilities into private company data. He begins by introducing Vectara's agent operating system, a SaaS platform that also runs on VPC or on-premise. Key platform features include advanced multimodal ingestion for images and tables, hybrid retrieval with metadata and reranking, and strong hallucination mitigation encompassing both detection and correction. Their hallucination detection model HHEM has surpassed 5.5 million downloads. The platform provides enterprise-grade deployment capabilities including security, role-based access controls, bring-your-own-model support, custom prompts, observability, and monitoring. Mendelevitch highlights that 73% of LLM customers implementing use cases identify factual accuracy as their top challenge, motivating Vectara's focus on hallucination mitigation. He then defines deep research as AI agents conducting in-depth, multi-step investigation by autonomously browsing and searching, synthesizing results into comprehensive reports with citations. Web-based deep research tools from Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Anthropic, and Perplexity typically take 20-30 minutes per query. Enterprise Deep Research applies the same multi-agent process with reflection, parallel execution, and synthesis, but queries enterprise data using Vectara's agentic RAG capabilities with corpus understanding for proper planning. Demonstrated use cases include responding to RFPs with 150+ questions, generating on-demand employee onboarding guides from Jira, Notion, Google Drive, and SharePoint documentation, and creating investment memos in financial services with extensions to healthcare and insurance industries.

sections.title: Vectara Platform Overview
sections.summary: Mendelevitch introduces Vectara's agent operating system as a SaaS platform deployable on VPC or on-premise. Key features include advanced multimodal ingestion for images and tables, hybrid retrieval with metadata and reranking, hallucination detection and correction including the HHEM model with 5.5M downloads, and enterprise-grade capabilities including security, RBAC, bring-your-own-model, custom prompts, observability, and monitoring.

sections.title: Factual Accuracy Challenge
sections.summary: Mendelevitch presents statistics showing 73% of LLM customers identify factual accuracy as their top challenge, motivating Vectara's focus on hallucination mitigation as essential for enterprise deep research quality.

sections.title: Deep Research and Enterprise Deep Research
sections.summary: Deep research is defined as AI agents conducting multi-step investigation by autonomously browsing and searching the web, synthesizing results into comprehensive reports with citations. Examples from Gemini and ChatGPT are shown, typically taking 20-30 minutes. Enterprise Deep Research applies the same multi-agent process with reflection and parallel execution to private enterprise data using Vectara's agentic RAG and corpus understanding.

sections.title: Enterprise Deep Research Use Cases
sections.summary: Key use cases include responding to RFPs with 150+ questions, generating on-demand employee onboarding guides from Jira, Notion, Google Drive, and SharePoint, and creating investment memos in financial services. Similar applications extend to healthcare, insurance, and other industries. Mendelevitch invites viewers to connect and request demos.
